summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a global offering of ADSs, ordinary shares, and pre-funded warrants. The offering includes 225,373 ADSs at $38.98 each, 1,959,289 ordinary shares at €33.60 each, and 345,099 pre-funded warrants, with an over-allotment option exercised for 33,805 additional ADSs. The offering was made under a shelf registration statement on Form F-3. This is an ordinary equity raise, not a special situation event, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, or liquidation.
